title: Motion-Picture Film (35-mm) - Prints Made on Continuous Contact Printers - Exposed Areas for Picture and Audio
scope: 1.1 This standard specifies the location and width dimensions of the exposed areas for picture and photographic audio on 35-mm motion-picture prints made on continuous contact printers. 1.2 This standard is applicable to the printing of motion-picture raw stock which is cut and perforated in accordance with ANSI/SMPTE 139 or SMPTE 237. 1.3 This standard refers to the adjustment of the printer, and is in accordance with ANSI/SMPTE 40.
